// GraphNodeAttachResourceConfig is an interface that must be implemented by nodes
// that want resource configurations attached.
type GraphNodeAttachResourceConfig interface {
	GraphNodeConfigResource

	// Sets the configuration, either to a present resource block or to
	// a "removed" block commemorating a resource that has since been
	// removed. Callers should always leave at least one of these
	// arguments set to nil.

}

429: func (t *AttachResourceConfigTransformer) Transform(g *Graph) error {
430: 	t.prepareResourceConfigAttachment(g)
431: 
432: 	// Go through and find GraphNodeAttachResource
433: 	for _, v := range g.Vertices() {
434: 		// Only care about GraphNodeAttachResource implementations
435: 		arn, ok := v.(GraphNodeAttachResourceConfig)
436: 		if !ok {
437: 			continue
438: 		}
439: 
440: 		// Determine what we're looking for
441: 		addr := arn.ResourceAddr()
442: 
443: 		// Get the configuration.
444: 		config := t.Config.Descendent(addr.Module)
445: 
446: 		if config == nil {
447: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: %q (%T) has no configuration available", dag.VertexName(v), v)
448: 			continue
449: 		}
450: 
451: 		if r := config.Module.ResourceByAddr(addr.Resource); r != nil {
452: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: attaching to %q (%T) config from %#v", dag.VertexName(v), v, r.DeclRange)
453: 			arn.AttachResourceConfig(r, nil)
454: 			if gnapmc, ok := v.(GraphNodeAttachProviderMetaConfigs); ok {
455: 				log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: attaching provider meta configs to %s", dag.VertexName(v))
456: 				if config.Module.ProviderMetas != nil {
457: 					gnapmc.AttachProviderMetaConfigs(config.Module.ProviderMetas)
458: 				} else {
459: 					log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: no provider meta configs available to attach to %s", dag.VertexName(v))
460: 				}
461: 			}
462: 		}
463: 
464: 		for _, r := range config.Module.Removed {
465: 			crAddr, ok := r.From.RelSubject.(addrs.ConfigResource)
466: 			if !ok {
467: 				// Not for a resource at all, so can't possibly match
468: 				continue
469: 			}
470: 			rAddr := crAddr.Resource
471: 			if rAddr != addr.Resource {
472: 				// Not the same resource
473: 				continue
474: 			}
475: 
476: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: attaching to %q (%T) removed block from %#v", dag.VertexName(v), v, r.DeclRange)
477: 
478: 			// Validation ensures that there can't be both a resource/data block
479: 			// and a removed block referring to the same configuration, so
480: 			// we can assume that this isn't clobbering a non-removed resource
481: 			// configuration we already attached above.
482: 			arn.AttachResourceConfig(nil, r)
483: 		}
484: 	}
485: 
486: 	t.finishResourceConfigAttachment()
487: 	return nil
488: }

555: 	t.configWalkModules++
556: 	if cfg.Module != nil {
557: 		t.configWalkResources += len(cfg.Module.ManagedResources) + len(cfg.Module.DataResources)
558: 		t.configWalkRemoved += len(cfg.Module.Removed)
559: 		t.configWalkMetas += len(cfg.Module.ProviderMetas)
560: 	}
561: 	for _, child := range cfg.Children {
562: 		t.walkConfigNode(child)
563: 	}
564: }
